storage.note: shards, runs, checkpoints and gate reports go to the private bucket; only released 8-bit models go public

gate/ownlogs_gate.jsonl.note: own infrastructure logs, scrubbed, EVAL ONLY, internal, never redistributed; limits from shipped 0.5.2 on this set (set before 0.5.10 trains)

licence.note: Train only on data whose licence allows commercial use (finetuning/dataprep/licence.py). tasksource rows are kept per row by the dataset's license_use; the sources below are dropped or kept whole, each with the licence text or URL it was decided on.
licence.tasksource_licence: tasksource/tasksource-jev-typed-decisions: per-row license_use = most restrictive of the source card and DPI licences; only 'commercial' kept (https://huggingface.co/datasets/tasksource/tasksource-jev-typed-decisions, README 'license_use')

exclude_sources.our-cases-public/ms_marco: MS MARCO: 'intended for non-commercial research purposes only' (https://microsoft.github.io/msmarco/)
exclude_sources.our-cases-public/bgl_logs: loghub: 'The datasets are freely available for research or academic work' (https://github.com/logpai/loghub/blob/master/LICENSE) - research/academic only
exclude_sources.our-cases-public/hdfs_logs: loghub: 'The datasets are freely available for research or academic work' (https://github.com/logpai/loghub/blob/master/LICENSE) - research/academic only
exclude_sources.our-cases-public/code_search: CodeSearchNet: dataset card license 'other' (https://huggingface.co/datasets/code-search-net/code_search_net); the corpus is code from many GitHub repositories under their own licences; commercial use not confirmed
exclude_sources.our-cases-public/defect_detection: Devign defect-detection set (copy used: mcanoglu/defect-detection, tagged MIT by the re-uploader); the original CodeXGLUE release is C-UDA (https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/code_x_glue_cc_defect_detection); commercial use not confirmed

kept_sources.our-cases-public/bigvul: Big-Vul: MIT License (https://github.com/ZeoVan/MSR_20_Code_vulnerability_CSV_Dataset, LICENSE); copy used: https://huggingface.co/datasets/bstee615/bigvul
kept_sources.tasksource-train: only rows whose license_use is 'commercial' (see tasksource_licence)
kept_sources.our-cases-conditions, our-cases-it-worke: generated by OpenJevX's own rule generators (finetuning/dataprep/gen_*.py), Apache-2.0; labels from rules. our-cases-logs is synthetic (gen_logs.py templates), not real logs
